title: Entropy-Based Measurement of Value Drift and Alignment Work in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on a general framework for quantifying 'ethical entropy' and 'value drift' in LLMs based on a five-way behavioral taxonomy (e.g., helpful/aligned, helpful/misaligned).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was not part of its investigation.
